note: WAEC Accounting round 7 (R35 top-up): debit note, pro-forma invoice, receipt, sales-and-purchase invoice; perpetual inventory; rate of stock turnover with the 4-times calculation; debtors collection and creditors payment periods; gearing; the 2:1 current-ratio tradition; three-column cash book; direct debit against standing order; error of complete reversal; profit on disposal N15,000; revaluation and depletion methods; interest on capital N20,000; bonus issue; share certificate; investing and financing flows; honorarium; entrance fee; Consolidated Revenue Fund; time rate against piece rate; overtime; fringe benefits; materiality; consistency; accounting period; discount received as income; drawings closed to capital; accrued income; income received in advance. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-6, NECO Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting
questions.q: When a buyer receives short quantity or is overcharged, the document he sends to report it to the seller is a
questions.explanation: The buyer debits the seller with the difference.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting
questions.q: A document that looks like an invoice but is only a price quotation, demanding no payment, is a
questions.explanation: It says here is what it would cost, not pay now.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting
questions.q: The document issued as evidence that money has been received is a
questions.explanation: It proves the cash changed hands.

questions.q: One document serves two masters: the seller calls it a sales invoice and the buyer files the same paper as a

questions.subject: Financial Accounting
questions.q: The inventory system that updates the stock figure after every receipt and every issue, so the balance is always known, is

questions.subject: Financial Accounting
questions.q: When a shop's stock turnover rises from four times to six times a year, this chiefly signals that
questions.A: cost of goods sold has fallen
questions.B: prices have been slashed by half
questions.D: goods now move faster off the shelves
questions.explanation: The shelf empties and fills more often now.
